title: An Advent Calendar of Days Out: 24 Festive Family Ideas
description: A days out advent calendar for December: 24 festive family ideas, from free light walks and carols to Santa trains, skating and panto.
h1: An advent calendar of days out
intro: Swap chocolate for memories. Here are 24 festive ideas for December, one for each door. Lots are free, and some are quick enough for a school night.

image.alt: Twinkling red and white festive lights

cardText: Twenty-four festive ideas for December, many of them free.

blocks.title: Scout’s advent plan
blocks.text: Mix tiny treats (a light walk, hot chocolate) with two or three big ones you book early. Not every door needs a ticket!

sections.html:
1. Walk to see the town Christmas lights
  2. Library festive story time
  3. Carol concert at a local church
  4. Christmas lights “safari” by car or on foot
  5. Frosty woodland walk with flask
  6. Visit a free museum’s winter trail
  7. Window-shopping for festive displays
  8. Make bird feeders and visit a nature reserve

1. Ice skating session
  2. Christmas market wander. See markets with kids
  3. Kids’ cinema morning
  4. Bowling and hot chocolate
  5. Pick a real Christmas tree at a farm
  6. Gingerbread workshop
  7. Festive farm park day

1. Santa Special steam train
  2. Pantomime
  3. Santa’s grotto
  4. Castle or stately home Christmas event
  5. Winter wonderland
  6. Theme park Christmas event
  7. Festive escape room (teens!)
  8. Christmas Eve walk and doorstep carols

Plan the big ones with our Christmas days out guide and the adventure finder.

faqs.q: What are free Christmas activities for kids?
faqs.a: Christmas light walks, carol concerts, library story times, free museum trails and woodland walks are all free or nearly free.
